findings.cause: Pending loop completion omitted tool principal/account/identity/role/session and connector authority.
findings.fix: Capture/recheck the tool principal and connector scope alongside existing task/owner/context guards; stale verdicts become state_changed/blocked.

finalDeclarationBuild.explanation: Final JSDoc-only declaration build changes 39 generated tool source fingerprints because the generator hashes all src TypeScript including comments. Replacing precisely those derived hash strings reconstructs the exact previously tested ESM/CJS bytes. No executable loop/helper code changed.

limitations: Model behavior remains nondeterministic; the exact recorded bad response is deterministically validated/repaired in tests and real Google recovery is verified, not silently accepted or skipped.
One repair can still exhaust its existing budget or fail validation; strict mode retains history and default masking uses retained evidence. No guarantee that every provider output can be repaired.
Local schemas enforce explicit structure/content bounds, not semantic truth. Host completion still requires authorized actual state/evidence.
Principal equality is conservative; host scope must remain stable during a pending check. No durable or semantic exactly-once action guarantee is added.
Standalone summary callbacks retain one invocation and transaction fallback. Public validationSchema is additive; absent options preserve old behavior.
Direct/external/realtime/native internal loop ownership is unchanged. Stage 12 and conditional Stage 11 remain separately authorized; no release.
